explanation: Super Mario Bros. came out for Nintendo's Famicom in 1985. Pokémon Red and Green followed on the Game Boy in Japan in 1996, and were released abroad as Red and Blue.

claims.text: Super Mario Bros. was first released in Japan in September 1985.
Pokémon Red and Green were first released in Japan in February 1996.
Super Mario Bros. was released for the Famicom, and Pokémon Red and Green for the Game Boy.
Outside Japan, the first Pokémon games were released as Pokémon Red and Blue.
